To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
teachers can promote school resilience by using their relationships to establish networks with service providers.
teachers can promote school resilience through the use of resources, forming partnerships and providing support.
teachers in schools can function as resources to promote resilience by establishing relationships with service providers that enable them to offer psychosocial support to vulnerable groups.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how teachers can be supported to promote resilience and how teachers and other service providers can be encouraged to collaborate to provide resilience-enhancing support to children in schools.
how teachers promote resilience in schools in the face of adversity.
the role of teachers in the development of resilient schools in the face of HIV/AIDS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

teachers in schools can be resources to promote resilience when they are supported to form partnerships with service providers that are able to function across systems to identify, refer and support vulnerable groups.
teachers can promote school resilience by establishing networks that function across systems and by providing support that is relationship driven.

teachers can promote school resilience by establishing networks with health and social development service providers that function as a system to support vulnerable groups, and that this system is relationship-driven and enables schools to function as a resilience-promoting resource.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
teachers are able to promote resilience in the context of HIV/AIDS and poverty by building relationships with community partners to provide school-based support to vulnerable groups.
teachers can promote the resilience of individuals and schools by using resources to establish partnerships and support vulnerable individuals.
teachers promote resilience in schools through relationships.
The main takeaway from our work is that
teachers can be trained as resources for resilience in schools.
teachers can be a resource for the promotion of resilience.
schools can become hubs for community-based resilience promotion.
